messages:
Marta S: FYI — Sunnyside (account lead: @sunnyside-ops) just emailed asking to onboard a customer-trained 13B model into our Private offering. They need PHI-safe inference, on-prem latency ~200ms p95, and a canary rollout. Request came this morning, attached their spec.
Priya K: thanks. Do we have an existing private package for 13B quantized at 4-bit for their infra? if not, that's a lead time question. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jin L: we have a 13B int4 flow we've tested internally, but PHI + on-prem will need KMS + audit logging enabled and an evaluation run with their redacted dataset. Also need to confirm GPU type (A10G vs A100) — perf varies.
Marta S: customer says they'll be on A10G hosts (on-prem cluster), 3 replicas for HA. They want deterministic rollbacks and an SLA for inference availability. Renewal is in 10 months; we flagged this as high-touch.
Nikhil R: propose steps: 1) security intake (PHI review) 2) eval harness + dataset ingest (redacted) 3) perf run on A10G 4) canary + metrics (latency, error, hallucination rate) 5) rollout plan. Who owns the eval harness?
Priya K: @Jin L can own perf runs. I'll take security intake with Security lead. Marta, can you schedule a sync with Sunnyside this week to get dataset sample? Prefer Tue/Thu.
Marta S: scheduled call for Thu 11am PT and sent calendar invite.
Marta S: attached the customer's minimal config snippet they sent:
```
model_name: sunnyside-13b-custom
quantization: int4
max_seq_len: 2048
private_deploy: true
kms_required: true
rollout: canary
metrics: [p95_latency, token_cost, hallucination_rate]
```
Jin L: good to have that. For perf we'll run both batch=1 and adaptive batching with continuous batching enabled. If p95 > 250ms on A10G, recommend fallback to 8-bit or smaller seq_len cap.
Nikhil R: For safety evals, we'll run the standard PHI checklist + prompt injection tests and include a small prompt set for regression monitoring. We should log per-prompt failure counts to Console and wire alerts for regression > 2x baseline.
Marta S: Sunnyside explicitly requested model locking (no updates without approval) and an audit trail for each model version. They also asked if we can do an initial 7-day pilot with limited traffic.
Priya K: Pilot is fine. Ops note: pilot + canary -> we'll need a deployment window and rollback playbook. I'll open a support ticket for deployment runbook.
OnboardBot: Ticket created: CS-3816 — Sunnyside 13B Private Onboard (contains checklist link: https://internal.redwood.ai/sops/onboard/CS-3816) :white_check_mark:
Jin L: rough ETA for perf runs and eval harness prep is 5 business days after we get the sample dataset. Security intake might be 3 business days.
Marta S: customer asked for an estimate of cost delta for dedicated on-prem capacity vs hosted. Nikhil, can you put together a rough delta/ops-cost note for Thu prep meeting?
Nikhil R: yes — I[0m'll draft a short estimate (token unit cost + expected GPU hours) and post it in the thread before the Thu call.
Priya K: tagging list of deliverables before call: - security intake completed - sample dataset ingested & redacted - perf run initial results - evaluation report (safety/regression) - pilot plan + rollback playbook
Marta S: perfect. Also logging renewal risk: high if onboarding stalls. I'll flag AM for customer executive touchpoint.
Priya K: thanks team. Quick reminder to update the onboarding spreadsheet with CS-3816 and add the renewal risk note. :memo:
Marta S: will do. Closing loop here for now — will share meeting notes after Thu. :wave:
